title: Palette (system-neutral)
description: One colour palette, independent of any design system. bin/gen-palette maps it onto the tailor tokens. Every value is a 6-digit lowercase #rrggbb. Dark palettes: inset is darker than canvas, surface/selection lighter; neutrals run darkest → lightest.

$comment.description: Source of the values (URL + file) and the licence situation; mandatory in practice.

id.description: Registry id (designs.json) and the theme name every emitter uses.

license.description: Upstream licence. 'values-only' when the upstream has no usable licence (GPL, no LICENSE file): only the colour values are reused, never code or assets.

mode.description: Which way the ramps run; color-scheme of the generated themes.

inset.description: Sunken surface: navbar, sidebar, code blocks, table heads (darker than canvas in dark mode).

selection.description: Hover / selected / current-line fill; also the muted background (shadcn --muted, daisyUI base-300).

text.description: Body text, ≥ 7:1 on canvas where the upstream allows.

muted.description: Secondary text; must stay ≥ 4.5:1 on canvas (lifted from upstream where needed, like Dracula's #a5b0d6).

disabled.description: Disabled text, placeholders, comment-grade decoration (Dracula's comment #6272a4). Not for readable text.

accent.description: Brand / primary hue: primary buttons, focus ring, active nav.

accent_solid.description: Optional darker fill for solid primary buttons when `accent` cannot carry `on_accent` at 4.5:1 (Solarized, Flexoki, Selenized). Defaults to `accent`.

on_accent.description: Text on an accent (or accent_solid) fill.

danger.description: Failed / destructive (canonical: red). The text-safe variant when upstream's red is < 4.5:1 on canvas.

info.description: Informational (canonical: cyan/blue); usually the link colour.

extra.description: The palette's named chromatic colours. The seven Dracula hue names are required so WebTUI variants, luz named colours and shadcn charts always resolve; a palette lacking a hue names its closest substitute and says so in $comment.

neutrals.description: Grey ramp darkest → lightest. Emitters pick extra steps from it (e.g. WebTUI background3 = first step lighter than selection).

roles.description: Chromatic hues in the palette's own order; used for chart / series colours.

light.description: Optional light counterpart (Dracula → Alucard). Same surface/text/semantic/extra fields; emitters that support a runtime light mode (bootstrap) emit a second block from it. Palettes without it keep the foundation's light theme.
